meta.name: liftover-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic coordinates between assembly versions (GRCh37/hg19 to GRCh38/hg38, mm9 to mm10). Guides UCSC liftOver for BED files, CrossMap for VCF/bigWig, and handles unmapped regions with provenance logging.

copy.tagline: 在不同基因组版本间转换坐标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理不同版本的人类或小鼠基因组数据
copy.tagline_en: Convert genomic coordinates between assembly versions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with different genome assemblies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把基因组坐标在不同版本（如 hg19↔hg38、mm9↔mm10）之间转换。它会指导你使用 UCSC liftOver、CrossMap 等工具，并处理未映射区域。
howto.when: 当你需要转换基因组坐标，或提到“liftover”、“坐标转换”、“组装不匹配”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 hg19 的 BED 文件转成 hg38。
如何用 CrossMap 转换 VCF 文件到 GRCh38？
say.note: Claude 会提供 CrossMap 命令和注意事项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help convert genomic coordinates between assembly versions (e.g., hg19↔hg38, mm9↔mm10). It guides using UCSC liftOver, CrossMap, etc., and handles unmapped regions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to convert genomic coordinates or mention keywords like "liftover", "coordinate conversion", "assembly mismatch".

say_en.text: Convert my hg19 BED file to hg38.
say_en.note: Claude will provide liftOver command and chain file download link.

say_en.text: How to use CrossMap to convert a VCF file to GRCh38?
say_en.note: Claude will provide CrossMap command and caveats.
